title: Business calendar
text: Weekends get a dashed outline and holidays a dot and their name.

title: Locale week start
text: Rows start on the locale's first day of the week, or one you choose.

title: Day and week keys
text: Up and Down move by day, Left and Right by week, Page keys by month.

title: Color steps
text: Discrete steps listed in the legend, with exact values in tooltips and the table.
